# ui::testing::VisualStates

Header: `winui/testing/VisualStates.hpp`.

Reads the interaction state a control draws in (Normal, Hover, Pressed, Disabled), which only a test looks at. The controls keep it protected; the free functions below are the way in.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ButtonControl button{"OK"};
button.set_enabled(false);
REQUIRE(ui::testing::visual_state(button) == ui::ButtonState::Disabled);
```

## visual_state

```cpp
template <typename C>
static auto visual_state(const C& control)
```
